mapper.select: select organization_code from evaluation_organization_mappings where user_id=#{userId} and status='ACTIVE' order by mapping_id desc limit 1

select achievement_id as "achievementId", management_no as "managementNo", evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", teacher_user_id as "teacherUserId", management_item_code as "managementItemCode", guidance_start_date as "guidanceStartDate", guidance_end_date as "guidanceEndDate", student_count as "studentCount", achievement_status as "achievementStatus" from student_guidance_achievements where deleted_at is null and teacher_user_id=#{userId} order by guidance_start_date desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from student_guidance_achievements where deleted_at is null and teacher_user_id=#{userId}

select student_guidance_student_id as "studentGuidanceStudentId",student_no as "studentNo",student_name as "studentName",guidance_type as "guidanceType" from student_guidance_students where achievement_id=#{achievementId} order by student_guidance_student_id
select achievement_id from student_guidance_achievements where management_no=#{managementNo}

select count(*) from student_guidance_achievements a join student_guidance_students s on s.achievement_id=a.achievement_id where a.deleted_at is null and a.teacher_user_id=#{teacherUserId} and s.student_no=#{studentNo} and a.guidance_start_date=#{startDate} and a.guidance_end_date=#{endDate}
select count(*) from excel_upload_templates where template_id=#{templateId} and business_type='STUDENT_GUIDANCE' and status='ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: insert into excel_upload_staging_rows (staging_row_id,upload_id,row_number,row_payload,validation_status) values (#{stagingRowId},#{uploadId},#{rowNumber},cast(#{payload} as jsonb),#{validationStatus})

insert into excel_upload_histories (upload_id,total_count,success_count,error_count,saved_count,processor_user_id) values (#{uploadId},#{totalCount},#{successCount},#{errorCount},#{savedCount},#{userId}) on conflict (upload_id) do update set total_count=excluded.total_count,success_count=excluded.success_count,error_count=excluded.error_count,saved_count=excluded.saved_count,processed_at=current_timestamp,processor_user_id=excluded.processor_user_id
mapper.select: select count(*) from excel_upload_files where upload_id=#{uploadId} and business_type='STUDENT_GUIDANCE' and status!='DELETED'
select count(*) from excel_upload_errors where upload_id=#{uploadId} and status!='DELETED'
select row_number as "rowNumber",row_payload::text as "payload" from excel_upload_staging_rows where upload_id=#{uploadId} and validation_status='NORMAL' order by row_number
mapper.update: update excel_upload_files set validation_status='COMMITTED' where upload_id=#{uploadId}
mapper.delete: delete from excel_upload_staging_rows where upload_id=#{uploadId} and validation_status='NORMAL'
mapper.select: select h.upload_id as "uploadId",f.original_file_name as "originalFileName",f.uploader_user_id as "uploaderUserId",h.total_count as "totalCount",h.success_count as "successCount",h.error_count as "errorCount",h.excluded_count as "excludedCount",h.saved_count as "savedCount",h.processing_time_millis as "processingTimeMillis",h.processed_at as "processedAt" from excel_upload_histories h join excel_upload_files f on f.upload_id=h.upload_id where f.business_type='STUDENT_GUIDANCE' and h.status!='DELETED' order by h.processed_at desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
